summary: Adds a final pass that strips all None-valued keys from the merged setting, correctly making `session.headers['X'] = None` suppress that header as documented. Fix is correct and general; only minor redundancy with the existing del-loop.

issues.description: New comprehension partially overlaps the existing `if v is None: del merged_setting[k]` loop, leaving two mechanisms doing similar work; the loop could now be subsumed, but leaving it is harmless.
